t: Introduction and overview — B-17 Flying Fortress
name: Introduction and overview — B-17 Flying Fortress — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — B-17 Flying Fortress
description: Introduction and overview of the B-17 Flying Fortress: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The B-17 Flying Fortress is a four-engine heavy bomber built by Boeing, the symbol of the U.S. daylight strategic bombing campaign over Europe in World War II. 12,731 were built. Flying in tight defensive formations, B-17s struck industrial targets across Germany; the type's durability and the bravery of its crews made it legendary. Baseline facts: Four-engine WWII heavy bomber; 12,731 built by Boeing; daylight strategic bombing over Europe..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: B-17 Flying Fortress: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Four-engine WWII heavy bomber; 12,731 built by Boeing; daylight strategic bombing over Europe.
Key figure: 287 mph top speed; four Wright R-1820 Cyclone radials; 8,000-lb bomb load.

title: Maintenance and operations — B-17 Flying Fortress
description: Maintenance and operations of the B-17 Flying Fortress: What it takes to keep this aircraft flying: inspections, spares, and support. The B-17 Flying Fortress is a four-engine heavy bomber built by Boeing, the symbol of the U.S. daylight strategic bombing campaign over Europe in World War II. 12,731 were built. Flying in tight defensive formations, B-17s struck industrial targets across Germany; the type's durability and the bravery of its crews made it legendary. Baseline facts: Four-engine WWII heavy bomber; 12,731 built by Boeing; daylight strategic bombing over Europe..

Four-engine WWII heavy bomber; 12,731 built by Boeing; daylight strategic bombing over Europe.
